acceptance_criteria: The resolved plan carries the declared fidelity limitations and an explicit non-readiness statement.
No artifact-availability, runtime-fitness, certification, or parity claim is produced by compilation.
Limitations are additive and do not silently widen the claimed capability.
Where the resolved plan records declared fidelity limitations under a finite library bound, that limitation bound is enforced over its declared scope and covered by an independent negative case.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.

review_resolution.note: Successor correction: the predecessor left the limitation-count bound without an independent negative case; the added acceptance criterion now requires enforcement and negative coverage of that declared bound.

statement: The compiler shall state declared fidelity limitations in the resolved plan and shall mark explicitly that a resolved plan proves intent validation only, not executable artifact availability or live readiness.
title: Declared fidelity limitations and non-readiness statement
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
